Circular No.- 10/2026
All Provincial Education Secretaries
Commissioner General of Examinations
All Provincial Directors of Education
All Zonal Directors of Education
All Divisional Directors of Education
Establishing 'Collective Circles' to eradicate all types of toxic drugs, alcohol and tobacco-related products from Educational Institutions under the state policy of creating a 'Drug-free Country with a Joyful Tomorrow'.
The provisions of this circular shall be prevailed beyond Circular No. 35/2023 issued on establishing 'School Friendly Forums'.
The use, sale, promotion of legal or illegal or toxic drugs, alcohol, narcotics and related products are strictly prohibited within institutional premises.

gold.issuedBy: Ministry of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education
gold.targetAudience: Provincial Education Secretaries, Commissioner General of Examinations, Provincial/Zonal/Divisional Directors of Education, school heads
gold.title: MOE Circular 10/2026: Establishing Collective Circles for a Drug-free Educational Environment

sections.heading: Purpose
sections.content: Directs educational institutions to establish Collective Circles to eradicate toxic drugs, alcohol, and tobacco-related products, building on Circular No. 35/2023 (School Friendly Forums) under the national drug-free country policy.

sections.heading: Key requirements
sections.content: Sale, promotion, and use of intoxicating substances (including narcotics, alcohol, tobacco, betel products, stimulants, and harmful energy drinks) are strictly prohibited on institutional premises. Heads of institutions must prevent promotion and sale targeting school children and staff.

sections.heading: Responsible parties
sections.content: All heads of MOE departments, provincial/zonal/divisional education offices, schools, pirivenas, NIE, colleges of education, and related centres must comply.

actionItems: Establish Collective Circles in each educational institution as directed.
Enforce a total ban on sale, promotion, and use of intoxicating substances on premises.
Brief staff, students, and visitors on Circular 10/2026 and prior Circular 35/2023.
Report non-compliance through the relevant Provincial or Zonal Education Office.
